component.name: Disc Shelf
component.summary: Rip Blu-ray discs and file the episodes for Plex

description.p: Disc Shelf copies your Blu-ray, 4K UHD and DVD discs to your computer with MakeMKV, works out which title on the disc is which episode, and copies the files to a folder on your NAS or media server, named the way Plex expects.
Put a disc in, check the episode list Disc Shelf suggests, and start the rip. It can:

ul.li: Match titles to episodes using TVmaze, TheDiscDB, the on-screen title cards, or a photo of the back of the case
Keep the original video untouched, or convert Dolby Vision and HDR to suit your TV
Keep only the audio and subtitle languages you choose
Copy each episode to the NAS as soon as it is ripped, check the copy, and ask Plex to look for it
Make a smaller AV1 copy of 4K films and shows on the processor or an NVIDIA graphics card

description.p: Disc Shelf needs MakeMKV, which is free while in beta and is installed separately from Flathub. The first-run setup offers to install it and checks that your drive is ready. Disc Shelf only reads discs you own; it does not download anything to watch.
